title: 第3章 一步踏出连杀五位大帝第4章 世间最好的修行道统道一圣地
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
赵族。
长生古族！
传承久远到可追溯至数万年前。
其现今更是如日中天，族内强者无数，为世间鼎盛大族！
陈长生竟说要灭掉赵族。
所有听到这句话的修士生灵，脸色无不大变。
赵族长沉着脸。
“你究竟是谁？”
他冷声开口，意识到陈长生非普通人。
唰唰唰——
赵族深处，恐怖光束冲霄，可怕气息波动席卷天地。
赵族所有老牌强者尽出，站在赵族长身后。
至尊威压蔓延，笼罩全城，他们全是至尊！
古城内的修士生灵，全被至尊威压给压的喘不上来气。
如若一座座大山，压在他们心间般！
砰砰砰——
大量修士生灵，更是承受不住这种至尊威压，倒在地上。
至尊一怒，伏尸千万！
“什么玩意，这么能装！”
九头狮心中冷哼。

小小的至尊，也敢这样装？
要不是没有陈长生命令，它不敢随便出手。
就这些小至尊，还不够它塞牙缝呢！
“主子真要灭掉赵族吗？”
它在心里沉声说道：“这赵族内恐有大帝坐镇啊！”
赵族的深处，带给了它一种恐怖的感觉。
如果没错的话，赵族的深处，必有大帝坐镇。
“我是谁？我是李洵的好友。”
陈长生抱着女童，向前走了一步。
轰——
顷刻间，笼罩全城的至尊威压，瞬间被抹灭。
站在赵族长身后的老牌至尊等。
更是接连吐血，倒在地上！
他们满脸惊悚。
这主究竟是谁！
content_en:
Zhao clan.
Immortal Ancient Clan!
The inheritance is so long that it can be traced back tens of thousands of years.
Nowadays, it is even more prosperous. There are countless powerful people in the clan, making it the most powerful clan in the world!
Chen Changsheng actually said that he wanted to destroy the Zhao clan.
The faces of all the monks who heard these words changed greatly.
Patriarch Zhao had a sullen face.
"Who are you anyway?"
He spoke coldly, realizing that Chen Changsheng was no ordinary person.
Swish swish——
Deep in the Zhao clan, terrifying beams of light shot into the sky, and terrifying aura waves swept across the world.
All the veteran powerful men of the Zhao clan came out and stood behind the leader of the Zhao clan.
The supreme pressure spreads and covers the whole city. They are all supreme!
The monks and creatures in the ancient city were all choked by the supreme pressure.
It's like mountains weighing on their hearts!
Bang bang bang——
A large number of monks could not bear this supreme pressure and fell to the ground.
When the Supreme Being was angry, tens of thousands of people lay dead!
"What the hell, you can pretend so well!"
The nine-headed lion snorted in his heart.
How dare you, the little Supreme Being, pretend like this?
If it hadn't been for Chen Changsheng's order, it wouldn't have dared to take action casually.
These little supreme beings are not enough to fill the gap between its teeth!
"Does the master really want to destroy the Zhao clan?"
It said in a deep voice: "There may be a great emperor in the Zhao clan!"
The depths of the Zhao clan gave it a terrifying feeling.
If it is correct, there must be a great emperor sitting deep in the Zhao clan.
"Who am I? I am Li Xun's good friend."
Chen Changsheng hugged the girl and took a step forward.
Boom——
In an instant, the supreme pressure that enveloped the entire city was instantly wiped out.
The veteran Supreme and others stood behind Patriarch Zhao.
He even vomited blood and fell to the ground!
Their faces were filled with horror.
Who is this master!
